These Word 97-2003 files come from the test data of word-extractor
(https://github.com/morungos/node-word-extractor, `__tests__/data`), MIT License,
Copyright (c) 2016-2021 Stuart Watt.

- test01.doc: a short test of insertion and deletion with Unicode.
- test02.doc: a long set of short random paragraphs with a wide range of styling.
- test03.doc: a page containing a table.
- badfile-01-bad-header.doc: an invalid Word file.
